entities.name: UE domain selection
entities.description: The procedure where the UE selects between 5GS and EPS domains for registration and service establishment.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that performs domain selection based on capabilities and network conditions.

entities.name: Domain selection criteria
entities.description: The set of conditions and parameters used by the UE to determine whether to select 5GS or EPS domain.

relations.description: The UE performs domain selection procedure based on its capabilities and network conditions.
The domain selection procedure is governed by specific criteria including UE capabilities and network availability.
